question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

My sister / is come for / a short holiday / from the US.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**is come for**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error in the original sentence is in the segment "**is come for.**"
